page_title: HOL 0-2 UNI | Holstein Kiel v Union Berlin 20/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' Holstein Kiel take a short corner instead of sending the ball into the penalty area.

90+7' Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. It will be a corner kick for Holstein Kiel.
90+4' Janik Haberer (Union Berlin) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
90+3' Union Berlin are ruled offside.
90+2' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Holstein Kiel comes to nothing.
90+1' A cross from a corner kick by Holstein Kiel is too strong and the ball goes well out of play.

90+1' Steven Skrzybski (Holstein Kiel) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot towards the roof of the net. His promising effort is kept out by Frederik Ronnow, who pulls off a stunning save! The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Holstein Kiel.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
89' 0 - 2 The score has changed – 0:2. Laszlo Benes sends a fantastic cross into the box from the corner. Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) jumps highest and plants a header down inside the right post.
89' Union Berlin get a corner.
89' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) takes a first-time shot from the edge of the box, but his effort is well blocked by the defender. Union Berlin have been awarded a corner kick.
88' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) connects with a cross near the penalty spot and produces a header which hits the right post!
88' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.
87' Bo Svensson decides to make a substitution. Aljoscha Kemlein will be replaced by Janik Haberer (Union Berlin).
87' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Robert Skov is coming onto the pitch as Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) cannot continue after picking up an injury.
87' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) looks to break free, but an opposing player clears the ball away. The ball is out of play. Union Berlin win a corner kick.
86' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
84' Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) latches on to an accurate pass on the edge of the box and produces a ferocious strike towards the left post, but his shot is well held by the goalkeeper.
84' Great teamplay by Union Berlin as they control the ball with a lot of short passes. Patience is the key if they want to find a gap in the defence to score.
83' Neat passing move from Holstein Kiel in order to create new attacking opportunities.
81' Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
79' Marcel Rapp has decided to substitute Armin Gigovic and he is replaced by Jann-Fiete Arp (Holstein Kiel).
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Marvin Schulz (Holstein Kiel) comes onto the pitch for Finn Porath.
79' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) earns the yellow card.
75' Kevin Vogt (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
75' Here is a change. Benedict Hollerbach is going off and Bo Svensson gives the last tactical orders to Jordan Siebatcheu (Union Berlin).
75' Here's the change. Yorbe Vertessen leaves the pitch and Laszlo Benes (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
73' This is a yellow card! Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) is not happy with the decision, but from our point of view it was clear.
71' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) fails to time his run beyond the last defender and the linesman makes a good call by signalling for offside after seeing the whole situation unfold.
70' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger.
70' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates as he overhits the effort.
69' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) makes a rough challenge and the referee blows for a foul. Union Berlin earn a free kick.
68' Patrick Erras will be replaced by Tymoteusz Puchacz (Holstein Kiel).
66' Timo Gerach shows a yellow card to Marco Komenda (Holstein Kiel) for his blatant foul.
66' Union Berlin enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

61' A dangerous towering header by Benedikt Pichler (Holstein Kiel) from around the penalty spot goes just over the bar. This corner kick didn't change the score. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
61' The referee awards a corner and Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) goes over to take it.
60' Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) tries to send a pass but it's blocked. The ball goes out of play. Holstein Kiel are awarded a corner kick.

57' Timo Becker (Holstein Kiel) has a chance after receiving a pass. He measures his shot from the edge of the box but it sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Union Berlin will have a goal kick.
57' Timo Gerach interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair. Holstein Kiel get a free kick.
54' A corner kick by Holstein Kiel is thwarted by the well prepared Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin).

53' What a sweet touch by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel) as he collects a pass. From near the edge of the box he produces a shot towards the top right corner, but the goalkeeper pulls off a decent save to deny him! Holstein Kiel have been awarded a corner kick.
51' The Holstein Kiel players are exchanging some short passes.
47' Holstein Kiel fail to score from a corner as Frederik Ronnow (Union Berlin) leaps to collect the ball.

47' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) was in a good shooting position just outside the box and unleashed a first-time shot towards the top left corner, but the goalkeeper made a decent save to thwart his effort. Holstein Kiel earn a corner.
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Marcel Rapp probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Magnus Knudsen (Holstein Kiel). He is replaced by Shuto Machino.
46' The second half has just started.
45+4' The end of the first half.

45+1' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) shakes off the attention of a defender and from mid-range lets fly towards the middle of the goal, but Timon Weiner is well positioned to make a comfortable save.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
45' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Union Berlin.
44' Tom Rothe (Union Berlin) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
42' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
40' Union Berlin are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
34' Marcel Rapp is forced to make an unplanned substitution as Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) suffers an injury and Steven Skrzybski comes on.
30' Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
30' The resulting set piece, sent into the penalty area by Finn Porath (Holstein Kiel), was easily dealt with by one of the defenders.
29' The game is interrupted now, Alexander Bernhardsson (Holstein Kiel) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
29' A clumsy foul by Diogo Leite (Union Berlin) and Timo Gerach blows his whistle. Free kick. Holstein Kiel will probably just try to cross the ball in from here.
27' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) is being substituted because of an injury. Bo Svensson sends Woo-Yeong Jeong on the pitch.
26' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) picks up an injury.
25' Union Berlin seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
22' Tim Skarke (Union Berlin) commits a foul after unfairly battling his opponent for the ball.
22' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) commits a rough foul. Timo Gerach stops the game and makes a call. Union Berlin have a free kick.

20' Armin Gigovic (Holstein Kiel) does well to reach the lofted pass in the centre of the box, but doesn't make full contact and his header drifts well past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
20' The Holstein Kiel players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
18' 0 - 1 Goal! A nice lofted pass into the box by Tom Rothe is pounced on by Aljoscha Kemlein (Union Berlin). His close-range strike flashes past Timon Weiner and into the top right corner. 0:1.
10' One of the players from Union Berlin times his run too early and the referee blows his whistle for offside.
9' Union Berlin control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.

9' Nicolai Remberg (Holstein Kiel) picks up the rebound from his own attempted pass and decides to shoot from mid-range. He shouldn't have bothered as the ball flies miles over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Union Berlin.
9' Holstein Kiel force a corner. They send men into the box.

8' The Holstein Kiel players are exchanging some short passes and control the game at the moment, but one of the defending players steps in and intercepts the ball. The linesman signals a throw-in for Holstein Kiel.
7' It's a throw-in for Holstein Kiel.
6' The Union Berlin players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

4' The game is pretty dull as Holstein Kiel are just passing the ball from player to player. Nothing lasts forever, though, and they finally make a mistake, allowing the opposition to pick up the ball.
2' The ball goes out of play and Holstein Kiel will have a goal kick.
1' That was close! Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) makes a good run into the centre of the box and gets his head onto a lofted pass, but sends the ball a fraction over the bar.
1' The match has just started.
The players are out at last! Union Berlin will take the kick-off.
Timo Gerach will officiate today.
